COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRLA No. 324 of 2015
And
CRLA No. 336 of 2015
Shri S.K.Mishra, J.
Shri Alok Kumar Verma, J. 
 Mr. Ramji Srivastav and Mr. Karan 
Anand, learned counsel for the appellant. 
Mr. J. S. Virk, learned Deputy A.G., 
assisted by Mr. Rakesh Joshi, learned 
Brief Holder for the State.
Mr. Pawan Pandey, learned counsel 
for the private respondent. 
This matter is put up on the 
strength of the application submitted by 
the learned District and Sessions Judge, 
Dehradun, for return of the original 
records of the Sessions Trial No. 25 of 
2011, State vs. Shivraj and others, for the 
purpose of conducting the trial of the 
accused persons. 
In view of the request made by the 
learned District and Sessions Judge, 
Dehradun, the original records of the 
Sessions Trial No. 25 of 2011 be returned 
to the learned District and Sessions 
Judge, Dehradun, after preparing both, 
hard and soft copies of same. 
List the matter on 14th December, 
2022 for final disposal. 
In the meantime, Paper Book be 
prepared and supplied to the learned 
counsel for the parties. 
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) (S.K.Mishra, J.)
 19.10.2022 Kaushal
